InstitutionFacilityEditController

class InstitutionFacilityEditController(view, institutionfacility=None, message_service=None)[source]

Bases: QObject

Controller for the institution facility edit/create dialog.

Fills the form of InstitutionFacilityEditView, validates the input through the service and returns the entered data to the list controller.

Parameters:
viewInstitutionFacilityEditView

The dialog view.

institutionfacilityInstitutionFacility | None, optional

Institution facility to edit; None creates a new one. Default is None.

message_serviceMessageService | None, optional

Service used to show messages. Default is None, which creates MessageService(view).

Attributes:
viewInstitutionFacilityEditView

The dialog view.

serviceInstitutionFacilityService

Service used to validate the data.

institutionfacilityInstitutionFacility | None

Institution facility being edited, or None when creating one.

ok_clickedbool

True after the dialog was accepted with valid data.

msgMessageService

Service used to show messages.

Methods

handle_ok()

Validate the input and accept the dialog if valid.

handle_cancel()

Reject the dialog without saving.

get_data()

Return the entered data as a dictionary.

list_types()

Fill the type combo box.

Notes

The OK and Cancel buttons are connected to handle_ok and handle_cancel. Saving is done by the list controller, which reads get_data() after the dialog is accepted.

Methods

get_data

Return the form values as a dictionary.

handle_cancel

Reject the dialog, discarding the entered data.

handle_ok

Validate the input and accept the dialog if it is valid.

list_types

Fill the type combo box with the translated types.
list_types()[source]

Fill the type combo box with the translated types.

handle_ok()[source]

Validate the input and accept the dialog if it is valid.

Notes

The data is checked by service.validate_data. On errors, a critical message lists them and the dialog stays open; otherwise ok_clicked becomes True and the dialog is accepted. The message header is translated with self.tr().

handle_cancel()[source]

Reject the dialog, discarding the entered data.

get_data()[source]

Return the form values as a dictionary.

Returns:
dict[str, Any]

Keys "id" (the edited facility’s ID, or 0 for a new one), "name", "type" (type code), "address", "phone", "email", "website" and "social_network".
